newsitem.title: USA: Flowserve names BW/IP's Bernard Rethore CEO.
newsitem.headline: Flowserve names BW/IP's Bernard Rethore CEO.

text.p: Flowserve Corp, the industrial flow management company formed by the merger of BW/IP Inc and Durco International Inc, Tuesday named BW/IP chief executive Bernard Rethore as the company's chief executive and chairman.
The company also appointed Durco's chief executive William Jordan president and chief operating officer of Flowserve, reporting to Rethore.
The executive appointments result from BW/IP's merger with Durco, which shareholders approved July 22.
Former Durco chief financial officer Bruce Hines will keep the same position in the new company and report to chief executive Rethore.
Flowserve said the company would have five business units, each headed by a unit president reporting to Jordan.

The company named Durco's Thomas Haan president of the Fluid Sealing division; Durco's George Shedlarski president of the ServiceRepair division; Durco's Mark Vernon president of the Industrial Products division; Durco's Reid Wayman president of the Flow Control division; and BW/IP's Howard Wynn president of the Rotating Equipment division.
In addition, BW/Ip chief financial officer Renee Hornbaker became chief information and development officer of Flowserve, while Durco's general counsel Ronald Shuff will keep the same position.
